purpose: Resolve the final four UNKNOWN states in V2_HEAD_PRIOR_CYCLE_MP for the 74-territory reasoner-power intersection. These decisions resolve identity/status only; they do not fit or alter any predictive effect.
closed_universe: Complete 395 elected members of the 2016-2021 House legislature from the already archived TAFRA/Chamber parquet universe.

decisions.evidence: The 2020 source explicitly identifies Ibrahim Chouikh as a parliamentarian and president of Lalla Mimouna. The 2021 pre-election profile independently identifies the same person as president of Lalla Mimouna. The Arabic closed-universe diagnostic found the corresponding Arabic-name variant but exposed a bilingual row-label inconsistency; the political identity is therefore resolved from independent context rather than the corrupted Latin label.

No exact Arabic match exists in the complete 395-member prior House universe; nearest Arabic candidate is a different person. The pre-election profile identifies El Ayadi as communications adviser to Saad Eddine El Otmani, not as an outgoing MP.

The focal PJD candidate was already a PJD regional secretary and elected regional/communal figure in Laayoune in 2015, and is described as such again in the 2021 pre-election profile. The prior House member with the similar name was the Mouvement Populaire candidate/member from Dakhla/Oued Eddahab, serving in Dakhla local politics and winning the Oued Eddahab seat in 2016. These are distinct homonymous political identities.
